name: Off Road Together
storyline:
Challenging Terrains and Obstacles
Narrow paths, steep slopes and deep mud-covered roads await you. Determine the right strategy and cooperate with your team to reach seemingly impossible points.

Vehicle Maintenance and Customization
Don't neglect the maintenance of your 4x4 vehicle to become the star of off-road! From tire selection to suspension upgrades, multiply your performance and dominate the terrain.

Camping and Recreation
After long and tiring drives, camp in the lap of nature. Gather around the fire, gather energy and set your course for the next challenging stage.

Strategic Route Planning
Just stepping on the gas is not enough! Plan well to maintain a balance of speed, fuel and endurance on challenging courses. When your timing is right, no obstacle can stand in your way.

Solo or Team Up
Put your solo driving skills to the test, or join forces with friends in four-player co-op mode. Team spirit makes the difference even on the most dangerous tracks.

Start the engine, defy nature and push the limits of your off-road passion with Off Road Together!
summary: Off Road Together: An adventurous off-road experience in single or co-op mode for up to 4 people! Drive 4x4 vehicles through challenging terrain, overcome obstacles and camp and rest. Upgrade your equipment, strategize with your team and reach the top!
